# EditHistory&lt;TPixel&gt;

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Editing` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public sealed class EditHistory<TPixel>
```

- `TPixel` - The pixel that surface stores.

## Methods

### Do(IEditCommand&lt;TPixel&gt;, IEditSurface&lt;TPixel&gt;) { #m-do-nfty-core-editing-ieditcommand-0-nfty-core-editing-4b3eb1 }

```csharp
public bool Do(IEditCommand<TPixel> cmd, IEditSurface<TPixel> surface);
```

Applies `cmd` and records it for undo. A no-op edit (Apply reports no pixel changed) is not recorded and returns false, so CanUndo does not light for an edit that produced nothing.

**Parameters**

- `cmd` (`IEditCommand<TPixel>`) - The edit to apply.
- `surface` (`IEditSurface<TPixel>`) - The surface to edit.

**Returns.** True when the edit changed something and was recorded.
